goal: Make Music Note / Library internal splitter movement in tablet-width panes use the same fast interaction geometry owner as the improved PC lane, while preserving 690 outer-window tablet improvements.

strategy.internal_split_drag: For fine-pointer PC Music Note / Library using runtimeProfile=library-590, lock the whole active divider gesture to css-var geometry across PC/tablet/mobile pane widths.
strategy.mid_drag_owner_switch: removed; content responsive mode may still change live, but geometry owner does not switch during the gesture
strategy.pointerdown_prewarm: enter css-var owner before the first pointermove to avoid the one-shot direct->css-var hitch
strategy.drag_end: restore normal 690/687 ownership immediately: tablet/mobile=result direct, PC=library-590 css-var
strategy.outer_window_resize: unchanged from 690; direct tablet geometry + 686 viewport windowing + 689 outer-resize isolation remain active
strategy.touch_path: unchanged; adaptive touch/Galaxy Tab engine is not forced onto the PC library-590 lane
strategy.visual_breakpoints: unchanged and still live during drag
